name: Enalyzer
description_en:
Enalyzer combines a business survey platform with optional consulting and managed survey projects. Its platform covers questionnaire creation, invitations, anonymity controls, background variables, reports and role-based collaboration. The service layer is separately priced help, not a prerequisite for every questionnaire.

The product is especially worth investigating when different stakeholders need different report views and a survey must connect to existing business data. Templates and AI guidance can assist drafting; they do not guarantee that a question measures the intended construct or that respondents are representative.
description_zh:
Enalyzer 将商业问卷平台与可选咨询、托管调查项目结合。平台覆盖问卷创建、邀请、匿名控制、背景变量、报表和角色协作。服务层是另行计费的帮助，并非每份问卷的必要前置。

当不同干系人需要不同报表视图，且问卷需连接现有业务数据时，值得进一步评估。模板和 AI 可辅助起草，不能保证题目测量预期概念或受访者具有代表性。

core_features.explanation_en: Integrated email and reminders work alongside configurable anonymity and survey languages.
core_features.explanation_zh: 内置邮件及提醒与可配置匿名和问卷语言配合。

core_features.explanation_en: Enriches surveys with existing context and describes API, SFTP, webhooks and Zapier paths.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用已有背景补充问卷，并描述 API、SFTP、webhook 和 Zapier 路径。

core_features.explanation_en: Shared workspaces and readers separate creating surveys from viewing tailored reports.
core_features.explanation_zh: 共享工作区及阅读者角色区分创建问卷与查看定制报表。

en: Share a department report without exposing individuals
zh: 分享部门报表并保护个人信息
use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Create an organizational structure, define creator and reader roles, prepare a permitted respondent file and test one survey. Decide whether consultants are needed for question design or integration, and request a quote for that scope. The reviewed platform is hosted; no self-hosted package or open-source license was verified. Microsoft Entra ID and SSO integration are described, but tenant-specific configuration was not performed.
steps.zh: 建立组织结构，定义创建者与阅读者角色，准备获准受访者文件并测试一份问卷。决定是否需要顾问协助题目或集成，并就该范围询价。所读平台为托管服务，未核实自托管包或开源许可。页面描述 Microsoft Entra ID 与 SSO 集成，但未配置具体租户。

items.en: Enalyzer may suit business programs needing tailored reports, retained organizational content and optional research support. A one-question poll may need less setup; recruiting respondents remains a separate requirement. Check invitation delivery states and source-data permissions before automating. The documentation advertises anonymity and data enrichment together, so verify their interaction for your survey. Exact email quotas, retention, recovery SLAs and connector retry behavior were not established.
items.zh: 需要定制报表、组织内容留存及可选研究支持的商业项目可评估 Enalyzer。单题投票可能不需如此多设置，招募受访者仍是另一项需求。自动化前检查邀请投递状态及来源数据权限。文档同时宣传匿名与数据补充，应验证它们在本问卷中的交互。确切邮件额度、保留、恢复 SLA 和连接器重试未建立。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Professional is displayed at €1,545 per user/year excluding VAT. Team examples show total yearly prices of €2,482 for two users and €3,873 for five; these are package totals, not per-user rates. Professional includes unlimited surveys with up to 50,000 responses each. Consulting and managed projects are additional. The page offers a 14-day cancellation/satisfaction arrangement, a free assisted pilot and a cover period until an existing supplier contract expires. None establishes an unrestricted permanent free platform tier. Reader pricing requires the full table or a quote.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Professional 展示为每用户每年 1,545 欧元、不含 VAT。团队示例为两人合计每年 2,482 欧元、五人 3,873 欧元，这是套餐总价，不是人均价格。Professional 包含无限问卷、每份最多 50,000 回答。咨询和托管项目另计。页面提供 14 天取消／满意安排、免费协助试点和现供应商合同到期前的过渡使用；这些均不证明无限制永久免费平台。阅读者价格需查看完整表格或询价。

review_notes: Original English synthesis with section-aligned Chinese translation. Vendor documentation is not an independent performance test.
Hypothetical workflows and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. No directional alternative relationship has been approved.

sections.title_en: Share a department report without exposing individuals
sections.title_zh: 分享部门报表并保护个人信息
sections.en: In a proposed employee pulse, prepare department background variables, set the anonymity rule, send invitations and reminders, then distribute a filtered report to each manager. Test a small group to ensure the report threshold does not expose individuals. The platform describes protected readers and multilevel reporting, but a technically shareable report still needs an appropriate audience. Review chart denominators when comparing departments with different participation.
sections.zh: 以员工脉搏调查为例，准备部门背景变量、设置匿名规则、发送邀请和提醒，再向各经理分发筛选报表。应测试小组，确保报表阈值不会暴露个人。平台描述受保护的阅读者与分层报表，但技术上可分享仍需要合适读者。比较参与率不同的部门时应检查图表分母。
